description: This Java source file defines an immutable command class 'RequestFromSubscription' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It models a command for requesting a specified number of pages from a subscription in a thing search context, including JSON serialization/deserialization logic and relevant metadata.

classes.name: RequestFromSubscription
classes.description: Immutable command class for requesting pages from a specific subscription in a thing search context. It includes fields for subscription ID and demand, and methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RequestFromSubscription with specified subscription ID, demand, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a RequestFromSubscription object from a JSON object.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getDemand
methods.description: Returns the demand (number of pages requested).

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command data to a JSON object, used during serialization.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, indicating it is a query.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command.
